segments.zh: 那么这是否意味着这个人并不那么严重或总是生气或不快乐？

segments.en: No, not an overly serious person.
segments.zh: 不，不是一个过于严肃的人。

segments.en: It generally means that the person is good at telling jokes and makes you laugh.
segments.zh: 这通常意味着这个人善于讲笑话，让你发笑。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So Jess has a good sense of humor and because of all these things and they've been together for five years, Mark says, okay, I've decided I'm going to pop the question.
segments.zh: 所以杰斯有很好的幽默感，因为所有这些事情，他们已经在一起五年了，马克说，好吧，我决定我要提出这个问题。

segments.en: Okay, this might sound very strange because you think, well, pop the question.
segments.zh: 好吧，这听起来可能很奇怪，因为你认为，好吧，弹出这个问题。

segments.en: What is the question?
segments.zh: 问题是什么？

segments.en: Well, in English, the phrase pop the question has a very special meaning.
segments.zh: 好吧，在英语中，pop 问题有一个非常特殊的含义。

segments.en: Means to ask someone to marry you.
segments.zh: 意思是向某人求婚。

segments.en: So if I say I'm going to pop the question, that means I'm going to ask someone to marry me.
segments.zh: 所以如果我说我要提出这个问题，那意味着我会向某人求婚。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Or you could say he popped the question last night.
segments.zh: 或者你可以说他昨晚提出了这个问题。

segments.en: We're engaged.
segments.zh: 我们订婚了。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that means?
segments.zh: 所以这意味着？

segments.en: He asked me to marry him.
segments.zh: 他要我嫁给他。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So it's a phrase to pop the question.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个短语来弹出问题。

segments.en: So whenever you use it together, you're talking about asking someone to marry you.
segments.zh: 所以每当你一起使用它时，你就是在谈论向某人求婚。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Great stuff.
segments.zh: 真不错。

segments.en: Let's listen to this dialogue one last time.
segments.zh: 我们最后再听一遍这段对话。

segments.en: Good afternoon, sir.
segments.zh: 下午好，先生。

segments.en: Is there anything I can help you with today?
segments.zh: 今天有什么可以帮你的吗？

segments.en: Um, yeah, I'm looking for a nice gift to give my girlfriend.
segments.zh: 嗯，是的，我正在寻找一份不错的礼物送给我的女朋友。

segments.en: Our fifth anniversary is next Friday.
segments.zh: 我们的五周年纪念日是下周五。

segments.en: Well, I would be happy to assist you in choosing the perfect gift for her.
segments.zh: 好吧，我很乐意帮助您为她选择完美的礼物。

segments.en: Is there anything in particular that you have in mind?
segments.zh: 你有什么特别想的吗？

segments.en: No, not really.
segments.zh: 不，也不完全是。

segments.en: I'm completely at a loss.
segments.zh: 我完全不知所措。

segments.en: Well, you can give her a set of pearl earrings or this beautiful heart-shaped pendant.
segments.zh: 好吧，你可以给她一套珍珠耳环或这个漂亮的心形吊坠。

segments.en: What is her favorite gemstone?
segments.zh: 她最喜欢的宝石是什么？

segments.en: That purple one.
segments.zh: 那个紫色的。

segments.en: I'm sorry.
segments.zh: 对不起。

segments.en: I've never bought jewelry for anyone and I'm kind of nervous.
segments.zh: 我从来没有为任何人买过珠宝，我有点紧张。

segments.en: Don't worry.
segments.zh: 别担心。

segments.en: We specialize in providing our customers a relaxed, pressure-free shopping environment.
segments.zh: 我们专注于为客户提供轻松、无压力的购物环境。

segments.en: That stone is an amethyst.
segments.zh: 那块石头是紫水晶。

segments.en: We have a range of beautiful amethyst pieces.
segments.zh: 我们有一系列美丽的紫水晶作品。

segments.en: Take a look at this bracelet.
segments.zh: 看看这个手镯。

segments.en: It's 18-karat rose gold studded with amethyst and blue topaz.
segments.zh: 它是 18 克拉的玫瑰金，上面镶嵌着紫水晶和蓝色黄玉。

segments.en: It's a great statement piece.
segments.zh: 这是一个很棒的声明作品。

segments.en: Oh, wow.
segments.zh: 哦，哇。

segments.en: That's really pretty.
segments.zh: 真漂亮。

segments.en: Jess would love that.
segments.zh: 杰丝一定会喜欢。

segments.en: But I was thinking of something a little more delicate, perhaps a necklace?
segments.zh: 但我在想一些更精致的东西，也许是一条项链？

segments.en: We have this beautiful platinum pendant or you could also get her a locket.
segments.zh: 我们有这个漂亮的铂金吊坠，或者你也可以给她一个挂坠盒。

segments.en: You could also get her a timepiece.
segments.zh: 也可以送她一块腕表。

segments.en: It's both glamorous and functional.
segments.zh: 它既迷人又实用。

segments.en: If you tell me a little more about your girlfriend, maybe I can help you find something for her.
segments.zh: 如果你告诉我更多关于你女朋友的事情，也许我可以帮你为她找到一些东西。

segments.en: Jess?
segments.zh: 杰丝？

segments.en: Well, she's very smart.
segments.zh: 嗯，她很聪明。

segments.en: She's a great sense of humor.
segments.zh: 她很有幽默感。

segments.en: She's very feminine.
segments.zh: 她很有女人味。

segments.en: Perhaps you could give her a ring.
segments.zh: 也许你可以给她一枚戒指。

segments.en: Well, actually, I was thinking about asking Jess to marry me.
segments.zh: 好吧，实际上，我正在考虑向杰斯求婚。

segments.en: I've just been so nervous.
segments.zh: 我只是太紧张了。

segments.en: Well, sir, I believe your fifth anniversary is a great time to propose.
segments.zh: 好吧，先生，我相信您的五周年纪念日是求婚的好时机。

segments.en: Okay, I've decided.
segments.zh: 好，我决定了。

segments.en: I'm going to pop the question.
segments.zh: 我要弹出这个问题。

segments.en: Fabulous.
segments.zh: 太棒了。

segments.en: We should look at engagement rings then.
segments.zh: 那么我们应该看看订婚戒指。

segments.en: Now, that's a whole other section.
segments.zh: 现在，这是另一个部分。

segments.en: So talking about jewelry and all of these gemstones, we also took a look at different metal types.
segments.zh: 所以说到珠宝和所有这些宝石，我们还看看不同的金属类型。

segments.en: We talked about gold, which is I think one of the most popular types of metals.
segments.zh: 我们谈到了黄金，我认为这是最受欢迎的金属类型之一。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's kind of like a yellow color.
segments.zh: 它有点像黄色。

segments.en: Now, when we talk about gold, we talk about 14 karat, 18 karat, 24 karat, stuff like this.
segments.zh: 现在，当我们谈论黄金时，我们谈论的是 14 克拉、18 克拉、24 克拉等。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So the karat, usually it's abbreviated like a K, 18K, 14K.
segments.zh: 所以karat，通常缩写为k，18k，14k。

segments.en: It means how pure the gold is.
segments.zh: 这意味着黄金有多纯洁。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And actually, they also use it in diamonds.
segments.zh: 实际上，他们也在钻石中使用它。

segments.en: They talk about a diamond that's one karat or two karats.
segments.zh: 他们谈论一颗钻石，即一克拉或两克拉。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So in diamonds, it has a different meaning.
segments.zh: 所以在钻石中，它有不同的含义。

segments.en: It actually means how much the diamond weighs.
segments.zh: 它实际上意味着钻石的重量。

segments.en: So some engagement rings are half a karat or a karat.
segments.zh: 所以有些订婚戒指是半克拉或克拉。

segments.en: And the really, really, really big ones are like two karats, and those are very expensive.
segments.zh: 真正的，真正的，非常大的就像两克拉，而且非常昂贵。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And we also saw another metal here, platinum, which is a very nice metal.
segments.zh: 我们还在这里看到了另一种金属，铂金，这是一种非常好的金属。

segments.en: It looks like silver, but it's stronger.
segments.zh: 它看起来像银色，但它更强大。

segments.en: It's much stronger, so you can hit something and it won't leave an impression.
segments.zh: 它更强大，所以你可以击中某些东西，它不会给人留下深刻的印象。

segments.en: It won't change the look of the metal.
segments.zh: 它不会改变金属的外观。

segments.en: And this is very popular right now for wedding bands.
segments.zh: 这在结婚戒指中非常受欢迎。

segments.en: You know those rings that men and women get after they're married?
segments.zh: 你知道男人和女人结婚后得到的那些戒指吗？

segments.en: Many people like to get this silvery-looking platinum ring.
segments.zh: 许多人喜欢买这款银色的铂金戒指。

segments.en: I've actually seen different types of metals that weren't mentioned in the dialogue, like titanium rings.
segments.zh: 我实际上见过对话中没有提到的不同类型的金属，比如钛环。

segments.en: Titanium is also a very strong metal.
segments.zh: 钛也是一种非常坚固的金属。

segments.en: I can't remember this metal, but it's used on spacecraft, and it's very, very strong, stronger than titanium.
segments.zh: 我不记得这种金属，但它用于航天器，它非常非常坚固，比钛更坚固。

segments.en: I don't know what it is.
segments.zh: 我不知道它是什么。

segments.en: And yeah, they also make rings out of it.
segments.zh: 是的，他们也用它制作戒指。

segments.en: But another interesting thing is some people make their own rings, their wedding bands or their wedding rings.
segments.zh: 但另一个有趣的事情是有些人自己制作戒指、结婚戒指或结婚戒指。

segments.en: I've seen that.
segments.zh: 我已经看到了。

segments.en: It's a very nice thing to do, I think, because it's meaningful.
segments.zh: 我认为这是一件非常好的事情，因为它很有意义。

segments.en: People like to do it together, and then they have these rings that are very special for them.
segments.zh: 人们喜欢一起做，然后他们有这些对他们来说非常特别的戒指。

segments.en: So a person that makes jewelry or makes rings is called a jeweler, right?
segments.zh: 所以制作珠宝或制作戒指的人被称为珠宝商，对吧？

segments.en: A jeweler, that's right.
segments.zh: 一个珠宝商，没错。

segments.en: So I have a friend who is a jeweler.
segments.zh: 所以我有一个朋友是珠宝商。

segments.en: He makes beautiful rings and earrings.
segments.zh: 他制作漂亮的戒指和耳环。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So not only rings, a person that makes jewelry in general can be called a jeweler.
segments.zh: 所以不仅戒指，一般制作珠宝的人可以称为珠宝商。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: A very interesting topic, especially for the girls who always love to have rings and diamonds and necklaces.
segments.zh: 一个非常有趣的话题，特别是对于那些总是喜欢拥有戒指、钻石和项链的女孩来说。

segments.en: Or the boys.
segments.zh: 或者男孩。

segments.en: I know some boys really like to get earrings or to have jewelry like a ring.
segments.zh: 我知道有些男孩真的很喜欢买耳环或像戒指一样拥有珠宝。

segments.en: I've never really seen too many guys wearing necklaces, though.
segments.zh: 不过，我从未真正见过太多人戴着项链。

segments.en: A lot of guys wear cross necklaces, I've seen.
segments.zh: 很多人都戴着交叉项链，我见过。

segments.en: Or rings, not too many rings.
segments.zh: 或戒指，戒指不多。

segments.en: I don't think it's a big thing.
segments.zh: 我不认为这是一件大事。

segments.en: Wedding rings?
segments.zh: 结婚戒指？

segments.en: Wedding rings, yeah.
segments.zh: 结婚戒指，是的。

segments.en: A lot of American guys wear rings.
segments.zh: 很多美国人戴戒指。

segments.en: Do you wear them?
segments.zh: 你穿它们吗？

segments.en: Yeah, I think, well, not a lot, but some do.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为，不是很多，但有些人会。

segments.en: So well, obviously it's popular all around and of course we are interested in hearing from you guys.
segments.zh: 好吧，显然它到处都很受欢迎，当然我们很想听听你们的意见。

segments.en: So if you have any questions or any other suggestions about this lesson or anything, you can always find us at EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您对本课程或任何其他课程有任何疑问或其他建议，您可以随时在 Englishpod.com 上找到我们。

segments.en: We hope to see you guys there.
segments.zh: 希望到时候见到大家。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Bye. Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。 再见。
